readout_other: Multielectrode array spike rate, burst number and burst duration (MC_Rack); bicuculline (25 uM GABA-A antagonist) condition
direction_notes: Spike rate and burst number increased with acoustic intensity (significant at the higher levels) and were highest at 50% duty cycle; the response largely disappeared with bicuculline, with a decrease at the highest level.
safety_notes: Mechanical index kept below 1.9 (highest 1.1); temperature change under 0.1 C; no neuronal death observed after exposure.

exposures.label: 0.5 MHz sonication of primary hippocampal neurons on MEA, intensity/duty cycle/duration/PRF sweeps

target.label: primary hippocampal neurons cultured on microelectrode arrays

device.model: custom-made water-immersion 10 x 10 mm square ultrasound transducer

timing.protocol_description: One minute baseline recording, then ultrasound for 20 s (except in the duration experiment), then one minute of recording; each parameter varied with the others fixed at level 2 intensity (level 1-5 in the intensity sweep), 50% duty cycle, 1 kHz PRF and 20 s.

Pressures were measured by hydrophone at the MEA surface through Parafilm in culture medium, 3 mm from the transducer, but the paper never says free field or water, so placed in unspecified_domain.
Table 1 gives ISPTA at DC 10, 50 and 90 % for five levels; the list records the DC = 50 % column (the intensity sweep used 50 % DC). Other columns not recorded.
Table 1 values; ISPPA calculated by the authors from hydrophone pressure.
